There are more scenic opportunities along the way, capturing the snow along with crisp, green pine and evergreen trees. Some really beautiful trails that you now have to pay a $6 fee to use or else be fined $45. You must scan a code at the parking lot using some app from what I see. So low income people and seniors who don't use smartphones are suddenly cut out from enjoying this area that was once free. Uxbridge Town Council says that the fees will go back into the maintenance of the trails. But a good portion of tax money from around the GTA already goes into paying for these areas. Besides, this is nature and nature has maintained itself very well long before humans ever existed. How much human "maintenence" does it really need? This is just another cash grab. I would encourage anyone enjoying the outdoors to visit https://stopuxbridgefees.com, sign the petition and read about this in more detail. Sign other similar petitions you come across. It's time to free up nature for everybody.
